newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Peru's Credicorp buys Colombia's Bco Tequendama. [CORRECTED 14:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Peru's Credicorp buys Colombia's Bco Tequendama. [CORRECTED 14:42 GMT]

text.p: Peruvian-based financial group Credicorp bought Colombian bank Banco Tequendama for $48.01 million (from $48.1 million) in auction Friday, Venezuelan State Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade president Esther de Margulis said.
Credicorp, the largest provider of financial services in Peru, paid $10,000 over the base price of $48 million for 99.99 percent of the Colombian bank.
Margulis originally said Credicorp paid $48.1 million. He later corrected that figure to $48.01 million.
Banco Tequendama passed into Fogade's hands when Venezuelan bank Banco de Construccion, which had a 55 percent share in Tequendama, folded during Venezuela's 1994-1995 financial crisis.
